item.createpneumatictools.hand_drill.too: Cuts through stone and earth at speed. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
Still mines, no faster than your _bare hands_.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_jack: A high-pressure breaker for the hardest blocks. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
On Obsidian, Deepslate and the like
Breaks in _a quarter second_, whatever the hardness. Netherite tier.
item.createpneumatictools.tunnel_drill.t: Drills _nine blocks at once_. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
Takes the _3x3_ around it, flat against the face you drilled.
Charged _once_, however many blocks were there.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_bore: Drills _twenty-five blocks at once_. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
Takes the _5x5_ around it, flat against the face you drilled.
Wider and _slower_, from _half_ as many bursts a tank.
Fells a _whole tree_ from a single cut. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
Brings down trunk and canopy together, for _one_ _charge_.
On Bamboo, Cane, Cactus, Kelp and Chorus
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_grin: A coarse abrasive wheel. Takes _one layer_ off a block. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_buff: A wax-loaded pad, spun fast enough to seal a surface. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
_Waxes_ it on the spot. No _Honeycomb_ to carry.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_vacu: Continuous suction for loose items and _Experience_. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
Draws everything within _eight blocks_ to your feet.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_wren: Portable torque for a kinetic network. Runs on _Air_ _Pressure_.
While R-Click is held on a still Shaft
Turns it at _64 RPM_ with _1024 Stress Units_.
_Matches_ its speed and direction. Still _1024 SU_.
When you let go, walk away, or run dry
